day_shape: Lebanon dominates: IDF medical officer killed by Hezbollah drone, Trump pressures Netanyahu to call off Beirut strike and announces fresh truce, UN Security Council emergency session, Iran suspends indirect US talks; UK Parliament silent on the file.

threads.label: Hezbollah-Israel exchanges and Nabatieh strikes
threads.summary: An IDF medical officer, Cpt. Dr. Ori Yosef Silvester, was killed and seven troops wounded in a Hezbollah explosive drone attack in southern Lebanon, with further rocket and drone fire on Metula, Safed and the Western Galilee. The IDF issued repeat evacuation warnings for Nabatieh and struck a car near Toul, wounding two Lebanese soldiers, while Home Front Command extended shelter warning times to 90 seconds for Haifa and 160 northern communities.

threads.label: Trump-Netanyahu call and Beirut strike called off
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Trump told Netanyahu "you're f**king crazy" in a tense call demanding a Lebanon truce, after which Netanyahu appeared to call off a planned Beirut strike and Trump announced a fresh ceasefire. Israeli leaders accused Netanyahu of weakness; Iran's foreign ministry deputy Gharibabadi said Trump's claim of stopping the Beirut attack proved direct US complicity in Israeli aggression.

threads.label: UN Security Council and UK on Lebanon
threads.summary: The Security Council held an emergency meeting on Israel's deepest push into Lebanon in over 20 years, with the UK Chargé d'Affaires James Kariuki warning escalation across the Blue Line risked undermining regional peace negotiations. UN Secretary-General Guterres proposed a new force to replace UNIFIL to police the Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire.

threads.label: US-Iran talks suspended over Lebanon
threads.summary: Iranian state media reported Tehran had suspended indirect US talks in protest at Israel's Lebanon campaign, while Trump said negotiations were continuing; Iran International framed Lebanon as a test of Trump's Iran diplomacy. Speaker Qalibaf told his Lebanese counterpart talks would halt and Iran would "stand against Israel" if attacks continue; Defa Press claimed Washington and Israel had retreated under Iranian threats.

threads.label: Jerusalem Post Conference: Iran regime-change messaging
threads.summary: At the Jerusalem Post Conference in New York, Mike Waltz said Tehran fears economic collapse and uprising more than US force and confirmed Treasury Secretary Bessent is leading the sanctions push, while Danny Danon highlighted a UAE-led UN resolution against Iran backed by 100+ nations. Netanyahu separately said Iran's ruling system had "cracked" and would fall; outgoing Mossad chief Barnea reiterated the need to topple the regime as Maj.-Gen. Gofman was confirmed as successor.

threads.label: IRGC posture and Strait of Hormuz messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said the IRGC navy authorised 24 vessels to transit the Strait of Hormuz in 24 hours, while Sepah spokesman Mohebi claimed military capability had grown during the ceasefire and Commander Asadi said Iran's production sites remained "hidden from the enemy's view". Iran's joint air defence command claimed billion-dollar losses inflicted on enemy drones.

threads.label: Khomeini anniversary preparations
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press detailed preparations for the 37th anniversary of Imam Khomeini's death on 14 Khordad, including a message from the Supreme Leader, a 09:00-11:00 shrine ceremony, Tehran Metro on full alert and highway restrictions on the Tehran-Qom and Tehran-North motorways. The Supreme Leader's special representative paid respects at Hormuz Island's martyrs' cemetery.
